meta.title: Two bids on two lines: award line-wise: line 1 to B, line 2 to A; approver approves with a remark
gaps: A prepared closed RFQ with two line items and two vendor bids at the specified prices.
Allocating line 1 to Vendor B and line 2 to Vendor A with exact quantities and totals of 900 and 250.
Verifying Awarded Vendors is 2/2 and the proposal total is 1,150.
Signing in as the separate approver and approving with the remark "OK — QA".
Verifying one PO per awarded vendor and that the event moves to History.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: A prepared closed RFQ with two line items and two vendor bids at the specified prices.; Allocating line 1 to Vendor B and line 2 to Vendor A with exact quantities and totals of 900 and 250.; Verifying Awarded Vendors is 2/2 and the proposal total is 1,150.; Signing in as the separate approver and approving with the remark "OK — QA".; Verifying one PO per awarded vendor and that the event moves to History.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed event's Master QCS; the prepared state is the closest available event but has only one line and one vendor.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the available line to the available vendor, exercising the closest supported awarding action.
Assert that the available single-line, single-vendor allocation was recorded.
Create the award proposal from the allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.

args.goal: fill the required proposal fields and submit the proposal; stop when the proposal page shows that approval is in progress

steps.note: Complete the proposal fields and submit them; no domain step exposes the proposal form fields generically.
Verify that the submitted proposal is awaiting approval.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver and approve the submitted proposal with the remark "OK — QA"

steps.note: A separate approver session is required and cannot be performed by the current buyer session.
Confirm the screen remains rendered without an error after the approval handoff.
